label: Fix: Tunnel of Pain crash
desc: Prevents the Tunnel of Pain / Coastal Rush stage crash.

label: Fix: Chicago Interstate crash (A)
desc: First of two patches preventing the Chicago Interstate action-level crash.

label: Fix: Chicago Interstate crash (B)
desc: Second of two patches preventing the Chicago Interstate action-level crash.

label: Disable checkpoint timer (1/2)
desc: Part of disabling the per-checkpoint countdown timer.

label: Disable checkpoint timer (2/2)
desc: Part of disabling the per-checkpoint countdown timer.

label: Disable out-of-bounds reset timer
desc: Stops the game from force-resetting your car after going out of bounds.

label: Disable wrong-way respawn
desc: Stops the automatic respawn triggered by driving the wrong way.

label: Disable 'rival getting away' timer
desc: Stops the timer that fails a race when a rival pulls too far ahead.

label: Disable drift assist forces
desc: Part of 'Disable All Vehicle Assists' -- NOPs the call that applies drift-correcting forces.

label: Show hidden UI options / unlock vehicle list gate
desc: Flips the visibility check so hidden menu items (and the full vehicle list gate) are always shown. 'Researched and discovered by _mRally2'.

label: Disable Align-To-Road assist
desc: Part of 'Disable All Vehicle Assists'.

label: Disable Override-Drift-Intent assist
desc: Part of 'Disable All Vehicle Assists'.

label: Enhanced drift physics
desc: Flips a single jcc that gates an alternate drift-physics code path.

label: Skip Race Line Assist calculation
desc: Part of 'Disable All Vehicle Assists': converts a conditional 'ja' into an unconditional jump so the RLA calculation is always skipped.

label: Disable Race Line Assist forces
desc: Part of 'Disable All Vehicle Assists'.

label: Skip Drift Intents calculation
desc: Part of 'Disable All Vehicle Assists'.

label: Unlock all vehicles
desc: Forces the vehicle-ownership gate to always pass. The source CT does this via a code cave that writes a flag then falls through to the *same* conditional jump; forcing that jump directly reaches the identical end state without needing a cave.

label: Unlock all Challenge Series events
desc: Forces the challenge-unlocked gate to always pass, by making the 'je' that gates it unconditional.

label: Force Race Line Assist status = Off
desc: Part of 'Disable All Vehicle Assists' (sets RaceLineAssist_Off).

label: Force blown-tire flag
desc: Directly sets the blown-tire flag byte. The source CT uses two different offsets between its enable/disable blocks (+110 / +114), which looks like an authoring slip; this uses +110 consistently so it behaves as a real toggle rather than corrupting an unrelated field on disable.

label: Force engine-blown flag
desc: Directly sets the blown-engine flag byte.

label: Enable fast boot (skip EA/loading logos)
desc: Skips the boot-time publisher/logo sequence.

label: Enable debug main menu UI
desc: Finish a race then Quit To Menu with this on. Do not open the pause menu while active (source warning).

label: Render vehicles in the main-menu garage
desc: Shows real car models in the garage like the demo build did. Can crash with many vehicles instanced (source warning).

label: Enable debug mode
desc: Enable before PRESS START or while in a level.

label: Traffic density scale
desc: Default game value scaled by this factor; lower = less traffic density. Adjustable -- default patch value 0.05.

label: Traffic max density
desc: Adjustable -- default patch value 0.15.

label: Traffic vehicle limit
desc: Adjustable -- default patch value 25.

label: Force AI difficulty
desc: Adjustable -- default patch value 3 (Expert).

label: Force-enable AI in events
desc: Ensures AI opponents are present even in events that default to none.

label: Number of opponents override
desc: Adjustable -- includes the player in the count. Some events break if increased too far (source warning).

label: Player starting grid position
desc: Adjustable -- 1-based starting position.

label: Remove vehicle event restrictions
desc: Lets any vehicle enter any event by nulling the CarFilter restriction pointer.

label: Difficulty scalar
desc: Adjustable -- default patch value 5.0.

label: Glue (traction) scalar
desc: Adjustable -- default patch value 0.7.

label: Vehicle damage / detach threshold
desc: Values above 100 make parts effectively undetachable -- a cosmetic 'reduced damage' effect. Adjustable, default patch value 101.

label: Time of Day (Career / Challenge Series)
desc: Adjustable TOD preset index -- default patch value 4.

label: Time of Day (Multiplayer)
desc: Adjustable TOD preset index -- default patch value 0.

label: (internal) GameTime pointer hook
desc: Exposes the live GameTime struct pointer. Drives 'perf_unlock_framerate' below -- has no toggle of its own.

label: (internal) Player-vehicle-control hook
desc: Exposes a pointer to the 'does the player currently have vehicle control' byte; surfaced as a read-only status indicator, not a toggle.

label: (internal, currently unused) variable simulation tick
desc: Not forced by anything -- see comment above.

label: Unlock gameplay framerate
desc: Removes the 30fps gameplay cap by continuously writing the desired value into MaxVariableFps once the GameTime struct is captured (happens automatically the moment gameplay reaches that code -- typically immediately after loading into a race). Only touches MaxVariableFps -- does not force VariableSimTickTimeEnable (see the comment above; an earlier version did, which is the suspected cause of a reported camera side effect).

label: Swap current car (Car Object)
desc: Writes a vehicle hash ID through the static Car Object pointer chain. Works reliably in single-player Challenge Series/story events (source note: does not work in multiplayer). See data/vehicles.json for the full real vehicle hash list.

label: HUD visibility (poke value)
desc: Two-level pointer chain to the in-race HUD visibility byte. The source CT exposes this as a plain editable value (not a scripted on/off pair), so which raw byte means 'hidden' vs 'visible' isn't confirmed -- try 0 and 1 in a race and see which does what.
